correctness.rationale: Direct block-determinant factorization (including Jordan cases) yields the exact scalar modal characteristic polynomial. Cayley invariance fixes a one-parameter orbit; bounding both modal square roots gives q<=2 sqrt(r)/(1+r) for every real theta and omega. Inverting the inequality gives a global bound, and explicit theta and omega yield a repeated root at equality. The equality-chain conditions prove uniqueness for u!=0; endpoint cases distinguish unattained infima. The bundled program executes 9,209 supporting finite checks.

value.rationale: The nonreal conjugate-pair class is the natural minimal nonsymmetric spectral case explicitly excluded by the motivating 2026 analysis; joint preconditioner and relaxation tuning is a real solver-design question. The theorem determines the complete sharp global rate, unique optimal parameters when u!=0, and limiting attainment phenomena. A nonsingular test system with u=1,v=2 has no convergent unpreconditioned real SOR but has tuned factor 0.03940575785. No unsupported floating-point or runtime gain is claimed.
